title: Privacy settings
description: The privacy settings the machine keeps, as it reports them. Read only: they are changed on the machine itself, never by the hub, and no tool takes them as input.

microphone.description: Known in version 1: none: nothing here opens a microphone. must-answer: the person at the machine accepts first. after-warning: it opens after the warning sound. The sound plays under both. A hub shows a value it does not know to Roy as unknown, and treats it as one that may open a microphone.

location_log.description: Whether location is logged over time. Off unless switched on at the machine.
